basic_details.job_title: RRI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Quantum Scientist / Quantum Engineer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Raman Research Institute (RRI), in collaboration with the IITM CDoT Samgnya Technology Foundation, has invited applications for two project-based Quantum Scientist / Quantum Engineer positions in its Quantum Information and Computing (QuIC) laboratory under India's National Quantum Mission. The consolidated salary is ₹1,00,000–1,50,000 per month with a 3% increase each year, for a PhD in experimental optics or photonics. Apply only through the online form at safal2.rri.res.in by 31 December 2026; the first tenure is one year.

age_limit.details: Age must be not more than 35 years on the closing date. Age relaxation applies as per Government of India rules for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC categories, persons with disabilities and women (as per NPDF norms). The notice does not print the relaxation in years. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

how_to_apply: Apply only through the online form at https://www.rri.res.in. Applications sent by email will not be considered.
Upload a CV with a full publication list.
Upload a cover letter (maximum two pages) on the experiment you would lead in QuIC and the experience you bring to it. Applications without a cover letter will not be considered.
Upload copies of two representative papers, or a thesis chapter if you have no published papers yet.
Give the names and email addresses of three referees.
Submit before the closing date of 31 December 2026. Applications received after it will not be considered.
important_instructions: Those already working in Government, Semi-Government, PSU or Autonomous Bodies shall submit their applications through proper channel. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates for interview to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualification and experience higher than the minimum prescribed. Mere fulfilment of the essential and desirable criteria does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview. The Institute reserves the right to relax any of the above requirements in exceptional cases. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the positions advertised. Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate.

content_sections.heading: About the QuIC Laboratory
content_sections.text: The QuIC laboratory at Raman Research Institute leads QuEPRAN, the National Quantum Mission technology group building a multi-node quantum repeater network for entanglement-based quantum communication. Partners are HRI Prayagraj, IIT Tirupati, IIT Patna and IISER Mohali, and Professor Urbasi Sinha is the Lead Principal Investigator. The first QuEPRAN node is being built at RRI.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The two positions are for experimental physicists and engineers with a PhD in optics. The notice lists one set of criteria for the post. Post-PhD research experience in optics laboratories Single- and entangled-photon sources, by SPDC or other means Colour centres in diamond or other solid-state emitters, including confocal microscopy Cryogenic experiments Quantum communication experiments Fabrication or characterisation of integrated photonic devices Taking laboratory results towards applications Age must be not more than 35 years on the closing date. Age relaxation applies as per Government of India rules for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC categories, persons with disabilities and women (as per NPDF norms). The notice does not print the relaxation in years. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.essential_qualification: A PhD in experimental optics or photonics, in physics or engineering, with hands-on optical alignment in both fibre and free space as part of the PhD work. Candidates who have submitted their thesis but not yet received the degree may also apply.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The salary is ₹1,00,000–1,50,000 per month (consolidated), with a 3% increase each year. The selection committee sets the starting salary within this range, based on the candidate's fit with the essential and desirable criteria and performance at interview. A consumables grant of up to ₹2,00,000 per year is available for the selected scientist's research. The tenure is one year in the first instance. It is extendable for the duration of the project (currently until 31 March 2031), subject to satisfactory performance in six-monthly reviews by an expert committee. The notice calls this a project-based position, and remuneration shall depend on availability of project funding.

content_sections.heading: RRI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Lead experiments on one or more subsystems of the repeater node: colour centres in diamond (nitrogen-vacancy, silicon-vacancy and other vacancy centres), entangled-photon sources compatible with solid-state quantum memories, light–matter interfaces, and Bell-state measurement and entanglement swapping. Design, build and commission the node's optical, cryogenic and detection systems, and set the standard of calibration and documentation the laboratory works to. Supervise JRFs and PhD students day to day in experiment, analysis and writing. Take experiments through to publication, as lead author on work led and as co-author on the papers of the supervised students. Contribute to the technology group's progress reviews and reports, and to coordination with consortium partners, including travel within India where the project requires it. Where results open a route to deployable technology, take it forward with the Samgnya hub and industry partners.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RRI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply only through the online form at https://www.rri.res.in . Applications sent by email will not be considered. Upload a CV with a full publication list. Upload a cover letter (maximum two pages) on the experiment you would lead in QuIC and the experience you bring to it. Applications without a cover letter will not be considered. Upload copies of two representative papers, or a thesis chapter if you have no published papers yet. Give the names and email addresses of three referees. Submit before the closing date of 31 December 2026. Applications received after it will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened against the essential and desirable criteria. Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed, preferably in person, and asked to give a short talk on their research and on the experiment they would lead in QuIC. The interview date is not specified in the notice. Shortlisted candidates must bring copies of degree certificates and grade sheets for all degrees, school final and higher secondary examinations to the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Those already working in Government, Semi-Government, PSU or Autonomous Bodies shall submit their applications through proper channel. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates for interview to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualification and experience higher than the minimum prescribed. Mere fulfilment of the essential and desirable criteria does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview. The Institute reserves the right to relax any of the above requirements in exceptional cases. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the positions advertised. Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidate.
